content.name: Liam Tran
content.title: Graduate Data Scientist
content.summary: Graduate data scientist in a Brisbane health analytics consultancy, with a Bachelor of Science (Honours, First Class) in statistics from The University of Queensland. Honours research on hospital bed demand forecasting led directly to my current role. Practical with Python, R and SQL, and careful about privacy when working with patient-level data.

experience.title: Graduate Data Scientist
bullets: Built an emergency department arrivals forecast for two client hospitals that is now used in weekly rostering meetings, with errors around 6% at the daily level.
Developed de-identification scripts and data checks for patient extracts, helping the team pass a client privacy audit with no findings.
Prepared plain-English model explainers for nursing unit managers, which reduced follow-up questions after each forecast release.

experience.title: Summer Data Science Intern
bullets: Analysed two years of point-of-sale data for 14 stores to estimate bakery waste by day of week.
Proposed revised bake quantities for weekends that store managers trialled, trimming bakery waste by roughly 12% over six weeks.
Built a small Streamlit app so store staff could check suggested quantities on a tablet.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science (Honours), First Class, Statistics
